info.title: Stock Quest - compatibility design
info.description: Design contract, not implemented Java endpoints. Based on inspected Express code plus local phase-2 fix. Current public fields and status codes are preserved; 503 is proposed for unavailable dependencies. Cross-field rules remain in application validation.
